answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Every claim climbs the ridge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the voyage re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the delta of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
